{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2009}}
{{main|2009 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2009 World Table Tennis Championships men's doubles''' was the 50th edition of the men's doubles championship.
<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Table Tennis}}</ref>
<ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsMD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsMD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-04-12|title=2009 results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref>
[[Wang Hao (table tennis, born 1983)|Wang Hao]] and [[Chen Qi (table tennis)|Chen Qi]] won the title after defeating [[Ma Long (table tennis)|Ma Long]] and [[Xu Xin (table tennis)|Xu Xin]] in the final by four sets to one.
